accepted.sentence: During appliance servicing, a hand-operated turning implement removes casing fasteners before technicians inspect or replace internal components.
A household repair drawer may keep one near cabinet pulls and door hinges for occasional hardware adjustments.
At bicycle workshops, mechanics use one to secure accessories attached with small threaded fasteners.
Model-building benches often have one nearby for assembling kits with miniature screw-fastened parts.
During furniture restoration, it can remove old mounting hardware before hinges or handles are cleaned and reused.
Field service pouches may include one for minor fastener repairs away from a fully equipped workshop.
After electrical work, installers may use one to refit faceplates over wall outlets and switches.
A maintenance station may stock several versions of this hand implement for fasteners with different head dimensions.
